In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], a small group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] under the leadership of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Skahtul]] captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] with the intention of cashing in on the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on him by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. With Skywalker [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a small cell, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Barabel '''guard''' watched over him, only for Skywalker to use a Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to mentally compel the guard to unlock the cell door and take a [[Sleep/Legends|nap]] on the bunk inside, thus allowing Skywalker to escape.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />
